LESSON: SIGN READING 2.2.2 READING READINESS.

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.2: Sign Reading 2.2.2 Reading readiness.
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign Reading 2.2.2 Reading readiness., part of Strand 2 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: How do we sign the things are found near our school? 2. Which letter sounds can you remember?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign Reading 2.2.2 Reading readiness. together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Critical thinking and problem solving: Researching skills as learner recognizes pictures of things found in the

neighborhood.

● Self-efficacy: Skills in knowing who I am (understanding self) as learner chants letter sound rhymes with confidence.

Values:
● Social justice: Cooperation as learner together with others share flashcards with fairness and without discrimination.

● Unity: Non-discrimination as learner works harmoniously with others.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Environmental awareness: as learner’s identifies pictures and name things found near the school.

Link to other Activity Areas:

Environmental Activities as the learner read pictures of things found in the neighborhood like animals.
